Silence ignorance ki consent ban sakta hai.
Grit rukavaton ko paar karti hai.
Grit lambi avdhi ke lakshyon ke liye junoon aur lagan hai.
Duniya sab ko todti; strong banao.
Hum sab ek saans door calm.
Khamoshi ek panah hai.
Himmat sahi kaam karna hai.
Taqat sangharsh se aati hai.
Himmat bhay ki discipline hai.
Grit har rukawat paar karti hai.
Jab sach bol sakte ho, chup mat raho.
Safal vyakti aur dusron ka farq taakat nahi, ichcha ki kami hai.
Jab hawa ka rukh badal nahi sakte, sails adjust karo.
Kismat hamesha bahaduron ka saath deti hai.
Grit matlab lagatar peecha karna hai.
Shak dushman nahi; darr dushman hai.
Kabhi mat chhodo—wahi waqt hai jab tide palat jayegi.
Tabhi bolo jab khamoshi se behtar ho.
Sahi karne ka time hamesha sahi hota.
Khamoshi ek shield ban sakti hai.
Fear ke presence mein action—courage.
